# Integration readiness: 100 apps for agent tool-calling

> For each app: auth methods, what gates API credentials, API surface, MCP server, and a rubric verdict. Every non-unknown value cites a URL + quote. Research date 2026-11-23. Agent: Claude Code subagents + Composio SDK.

## Files
- [findings.json](findings.json): full records with evidence
- [findings.csv](findings.csv): one row per app
- [schema.json](schema.json): JSON Schema of a record
- [human_check.csv](human_check.csv): gold-sample human audit sheet

## Verdict counts
- BUILD_NOW: 36
- BUILD_WITH_CAVEATS: 52
- BLOCKED_NEEDS_OUTREACH: 7
- BLOCKED_NO_PUBLIC_API: 0
- NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_A_SERVICE: 2
- UNCLEAR: 3

## Headline findings
- 60 of 100 apps give a developer working API credentials free and self-serve (46 free, 14 via trial).
- 37 of 100 are gated. The most common gate is paid plan required (15 apps); only 4 require partner or sales contact.
- Auth is dominated by oauth2 (70 apps) and api_key (47); 70 apps support OAuth 2.0, so per-user OAuth is the norm Composio must handle.
- 72 of 100 vendors now publish an official MCP server; 16 more have only community servers.
- 36 apps are BUILD_NOW. 3 of them have no Composio toolkit today: LiveAgent, systeme.io, Vonage.
- Finance apps: 5 of 9 gated vs 32 of 88 in other categories.
- Verification changed the verdict for 36 of 100 apps versus the single-shot pass 1; access went from 59 unknown to 3 unknown.
